name: 29045 · Elgin, SC
findings: ZIP 29045 (Elgin) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29045 (Elgin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29045 (Elgin) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
